title: Associate Teacher
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

outcomes: Integrate understanding of the needs, the characteristics, and multiple influences on development of all children birth to age eight as related to high quality care and education of young children.
Analyze, demonstrate, and evaluate effective practice in working with young children.
Design, implement, and evaluate environments and activities that support positive developmental play and learning outcomes for all young children.
Apply effective guidance and interaction strategies that support all children’s social learning, identity, and self-confidence.
Apply ethical standards and professional behaviors that demonstrate understanding and knowledge, deepening the commitment to Early Care and Education profession.

notes: The catalog prints 'ECE 31 Introduction to Curriculum'; the trailing 1 is a footnote marker (immunization/TB verification), so the course is recorded as ECE 3 (closed list ECE 3, Introduction to Curriculum).
ECE 19 (Work Experience Education, Early Childhood Education) is printed as 'ECE 19 1, 2' with footnote markers 1 and 2; it is not in the closed list and is recorded as a catalog addition.

Program learning outcomes are printed once under the EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION heading for the department's certificates and degrees as a whole; this certificate shares that list, so it is recorded here. Reviewer should confirm.

Careers taken from the Associate Teacher description: 'work as a teacher in a private early care and education program' and 'work as an assistant or associate teacher in a publicly funded (Title 5) early care and education program'.
Completion also requires 150 hours of experience (met via ECE 19 through employment or volunteering), per the description and footnote 2.
